limitations: No measurement series are recorded: the article has no individual patients, and the main-article tables are single cohort-level rows (Table 1 baseline characteristics, Tables 2 and 3 pre- and post-treatment group means) with no per-patient serial values.
The only per-participant table is supplement Table S.3 (P1 to P14), whose ownership is unresolved and whose supplement review is partial, so it cannot be used as a supplement transcription series.
